name: nimbus-synthetic-heldout
description: Held-out questions over the synthetic Nimbus CRM corpus. Written before any run and never used to adjust thresholds or rules. Not Salesforce.

records.question: Do I still need to loop over X-Nimbus-Cursor pages when exporting records in bulk?
records.reference_answer: No. Since Winter '25 the v2 engine returns up to 50,000 records per call; the pagination loop is unnecessary.

records.question: How do I export more than 2,000 records with BulkExportService?
records.reference_answer: Paginate manually with the cursorToken from the X-Nimbus-Cursor header.

records.question: Is the Async Trigger Framework available?
records.reference_answer: No. It was introduced in Spring '25.

records.question: How many async handlers can I register per object?
records.reference_answer: Up to 50 async handlers per object.

records.question: What should I use instead of LegacySyncCallout?
Is LegacySyncCallout.send() deprecated?
records.reference_answer: Not on Spring '24; the deprecation starts in Summer '24.

records.question: What is the retention window for Field History?
records.reference_answer: Sources conflict (18 vs 24 months) with unknown applicability; surface the conflict.

records.question: How do I configure single sign-on with SAML in Nimbus CRM?
records.reference_answer: Not documented in the knowledge base; abstain.

records.question: I'm getting JOB_CHAIN_DEPTH_EXCEEDED, what does it mean?
records.reference_answer: A QueueableJob tried to enqueue more than one child job from execute().

records.question: Can I wrap DML in LockRetryUtil.withRetry(3) to handle UNABLE_TO_LOCK_ROW?
records.reference_answer: Yes, on Summer '24 the retry pattern applies.

records.question: What is the scheduled job concurrency limit?
How large should a Platform Cache partition be?
records.reference_answer: A community note suggests at least 5 MB, but its applicability to any release is unknown.
